techniques.magma: Fire technique on a stone: seize it and melt it; release to pour a lava wave.
techniques.heat_draw: Fire technique on lava or hot rock: extract heat into your reserve.
techniques.lightning: Fire: hold attack to charge a lightning strike that follows conductors.
techniques.redirect_current: Fire guard timed against lightning sends it back.
techniques.glide: Air technique: keep holding after an updraft to glide.

air_dash.name: Air Dash
air_dash.desc: A 4.6 m burst of wind with i-frames (legacy). Hold EVADE: Tailwind run.

earth_attack.name: Stone Shot
earth_attack.desc: Rip a 20 kg stone and throw it @17. Hold: Heave 45 kg (legacy) -> Boulder 65 kg @12 -> Crag Breaker 80 kg @11 that bursts into 3 rubble.

earth_tech.name: Seize / Split
earth_tech.desc: Seize a stone <= 80 kg at 7.5 m (incoming preferred), drag-aim, release to throw. T+A Split: three spikes fanned 30° @20 m/s - split it and spike it back.

water_attack.name: Lash / Ice Lance / Torrent / Maelstrom
water_attack.desc: Tap: wetting lash. Hold: ice lance (T1). Hold longer: Torrent, a 10 kg water slug (T2), then Maelstrom Lash, a 360 degree whip (T3).

water_tech.name: Draw & Shape
water_tech.desc: Hold: draw water from the pool, a puddle, vapour (condense it) or an enemy stream in flight; drag to aim; release to fire. Attack while holding: freeze it into an ice block.

fire_attack.name: Flare / Blaze / Fire Column / Inferno
fire_attack.desc: Tap: a flare cone. Hold: the blaze (T1). Hold 1 s: Fire Column, a narrow 7 m jet that leaves a burning field. Hold 1.8 s: Inferno, a 9 m wide blaze and a 4 s field.

fire_tech.name: Thermal (HEAT / DRAW / VENT / SCORCH)
fire_tech.desc: Hold on a stone: magma grip, melt it, release to pour a lava wave. On lava or hot rock: DRAW its heat into your reserve. On a wall or a body you can't grip: SCORCH its face at 300 HU/s (walls slump). Nothing in reach and heat in reserve: VENT.

air_attack.name: Palm Gust
air_attack.desc: A palm of wind: turns light shots and disperses clouds. Hold: Cyclone Push (legacy), then Gale (8 m, 50 deg) and Hurricane Palm (10 m, 60 deg) - strong enough to crust and stall a lava wave. Pressure 7 / 11 / 18 / 28 against what it meets.

air_tech.name: Updraft / Wind Grip
air_tech.desc: Context: a light body (<= 30 kg, fireballs too) in the aim cone within 9 m -> Wind Grip (seize it, drag-aim, release to fling; a gripped fireball grows 20 %). Otherwise Updraft: lift 2 m, keep holding to glide.

spear_stone.name: Spear Stone
spear_stone.desc: A flat 12 kg stone spear ripped from the ground @26 m/s. Hold: twin, triple, Pike Volley.

rising_fangs.name: Rising Fangs
rising_fangs.desc: A spike line races 9 m along the ground and launches; the spikes stand 1.5 s as a low wall that stops ground lines. T3 Earthrise: a ring of spikes around you.

rubble_fan.name: Rubble Fan
rubble_fan.desc: 3 x 6 kg rubble fanned 40°. Hold: 5, 7, then 9 skipping stones.

ram_wall.name: Ram Wall
ram_wall.desc: The standing wall slides 6 m @9 m/s, shoving bodies and waves back; pushing an enemy wall is a contest (your K vs their CP). Then it crumbles to rubble.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.desc: The ground opens in a 6 m 60° cone: solids sink (booked as ground_returned), lava waves drain into the trench. Strength from guard hold time.

stone_skin.name: Stone Skin
stone_skin.desc: Hold EVADE in place: 40 % armor vs kinetic hits, anchored (no knockback / pull / lift), speed x0.4. Hold EVADE with a direction: Burrow Step - sink and resurface 3.5 m away (passes under ground lines).

razor_disc.name: Razor Disc
razor_disc.desc: A 2 kg disc from the satchel @24 m/s, homing 10°/s. Hold: pincer (2 curving), ricochet (3 bounce once), Disc Storm (5 orbit you 0.6 s, then fire).

iron_lance.name: Iron Lance
iron_lance.desc: A 6 kg lance @30 m/s; T2 pierces one body; T3 Railspike 12 kg @42. Embeds in stone and glass walls as a conductive rod.

lodestone_line.name: Lodestone Line
lodestone_line.desc: Iron filings snake 8 m along the ground and spring into caltrops r 2 m for 4 s (slow 40 %, chip 2/s, a conductor node). T3 Iron Garden r 4 m.

chain_arc.name: Chain Arc
chain_arc.desc: A 5 m chain sweeps 120°: yanks light fighters 2 m toward you and wraps stones / metal <= 20 kg out of the air to your feet. T2 heavy yank, T3 Whirling Chain 360°.

aegis_plate.name: Aegis Plate
aegis_plate.desc: Hold a 6 kg plate from the satchel (CP 20). Heats under flames (>= 300 °C it is dropped); grounds bolts on stone, conducts them into you in water or on the plate. Perfect: Magnet Catch (metal into the satchel), stones deflect.

plate_rush.name: Plate Rush
plate_rush.desc: Hurl the held plate spinning @20 m/s.

rod_plant.name: Rod Plant
rod_plant.desc: Plant a 3 kg rod: for 8 s bolts within 6 m are drawn to it and grounded (capacity 60; above it the rod melts). A rod touching a puddle conducts into it.

lodestone_grip.name: Lodestone Grip
lodestone_grip.desc: Seize metal <= 80 kg at 10 m (grip x1.3, steals the rival's discs, lances and plates); on the arena plate rip 10 kg of scrap. T+A Reforge: lance -> 3 shards -> disc. Nothing to grip: Recall - every piece you own flies back (and hits what is in between).

magnet_glide.name: Magnet Glide
magnet_glide.desc: Dash 6 m toward the nearest metal within 8 m (rod, plate, disc...), else a 3 m sidestep.

iron_stance.name: Iron Stance
iron_stance.desc: While held: anchored (no knockback / pull / lift) and 25 % armor; speed x0.5.

grit_shot.name: Grit Shot
grit_shot.desc: A 5 kg sand slug @22 that bursts on hit (blind 1 s). Hold: 3 slugs, Sand Cannon (15 kg, bursts into a 2 m cloud), Dune Breaker (30 kg, a 4 m sandstorm for 3 s).

sandblast.name: Sandblast
sandblast.desc: An abrasive jet 8 m: abrades barriers (glass, ice, vines x2), dries wet targets. Hold: 10 m, a 1 s sustained jet, Scour (2 s, cuts ice walls and vines).

sand_surge.name: Sand Surge
sand_surge.desc: A sand wave 9 m/s, 2 m wide, 10 m: knockdown, carries loose solids back, buries puddles (mud), smothers fire fields, crusts lava (x1.5). Hold: wider, tall (stops projectiles), Desert Tide (4 m, 14 m).

veil_of_grit.name: Veil of Grit
veil_of_grit.desc: A sand cloud ahead (r 4 m, 2.5 s): blocks lock-on, smothers flames (x2), drags projectiles (-30 % K), halves bolts that cross it and fuses glass. T3: an 8 m sandstorm.

dune_wall.name: Dune Wall
dune_wall.desc: A porous 100 kg sand wall (held: 130 / 160 kg, CP 25 / 32 / 40): captures solids (x1.2), smothers fire (x2), absorbs blasts and sound (x1.5), grounds bolts (cap 60) and turns to glass; water makes it a mud wall. Perfect Engulf: a projectile <= 30 kg is swallowed and spat back.

dune_push.name: Dune Push
dune_push.desc: The dune collapses forward into a Sand Surge (its mass - the wall's hold - is the wave's power).

quicksand.name: Quicksand
quicksand.desc: A 3 m pit in front for 5 s (strength by guard hold, CP 18 / 26 / 36 / 50): walkers x0.3 speed, rooted after 1 s; landing solids sink; lava entering crusts to glass; water poured in makes a mud bog.

sandform.name: Sandform
sandform.desc: Gather sand from the ground (6 kg/s up to 30 kg) or seize the rival's sand (slugs, surges, clouds); release = a sand spear. T+A Compress: sandstone (stone, same mass) - throw it as a stone.

sand_surf.name: Sand Surf
sand_surf.desc: A 4 m slide on a skin of sand.

sand_ride.name: Sand Surf (ride)
sand_ride.desc: Ride a self-made sand wave at 8 m/s while held (10 Focus/s).

ember_clot.name: Ember Clot
ember_clot.desc: A 4 kg molten glob @18 (burn 2 s). Hold: 3 globs, Magma Bomb (12 kg lobbed, a 2 m lava puddle), Caldera (20 kg lobbed, a 3.5 m lava pool).

lava_lash.name: Lava Lash
lava_lash.desc: A lava whip 6 m 25° (melts ice x3, burns vines x3). Hold: 7 m, a 0.6 s stream, Molten Lance (a 10 m jet that pours 300 HU into a wall face: two lances slump a Bulwark).

magma_surge.name: Magma Surge
magma_surge.desc: Re-pour every molten body within 6 m (yours, the rival's, a slumped wall, lava pools, rifts) as a wave toward the aim - push it back on them. No lava near: raise an 8 kg vein (+160 HU). Hold: more budget; T3 Lava Tide merges all of it into one wave.

spatter_arc.name: Spatter Arc
spatter_arc.desc: 5 x 1 kg molten droplets fanned 70° (burn, scorch, ignite vines). Hold: 7, 9, then a ring.

magma_curtain.name: Magma Curtain
magma_curtain.desc: A 100 kg stone wall with a molten face (CP 28; set by water: obsidian 38, brittle to sound). Small solids stick in the face and heat; lava is absorbed; flames feed it; water bursts to steam. Perfect: the projectile fuses into the wall.

slag_wave.name: Slag Wave
slag_wave.desc: The curtain's molten face slumps forward as a 15 kg lava wave (+150 HU).

melt_pit.name: Melt Pit
melt_pit.desc: A 2.5 m molten pit in front for 2 s (strength by guard hold, CP 20 / 28 / 38 / 50): landing solids melt into it while its heat lasts; ice boils; walkers burn.

magma_hold.name: Magma Hold
magma_hold.desc: Seize molten or hot stone at 8 m without burns (blobs, slumped walls, lava pools, the rival's waves); release = pour a wave (molten) or throw (solid). T+A Cool & Set: dump the heat into the ground - solid rock in hand. On an enemy lava wave: a grip contest vs the pourer's authority; win = the wave turns around (Reverse Tide).

cinder_step.name: Cinder Step
cinder_step.desc: A 3.5 m dash leaving an ember trail.

lava_wade.name: Lava Wade
lava_wade.desc: While held: immune to lava and hot-rock burns, walk through lava at x0.6 (10 Focus/s).

water_bullet.name: Water Bullet
water_bullet.desc: A fast water slug. Held: a triple volley, then the Pressure Jet (a jet still connected to you: lightning on it comes back to you), then the Cutting Jet.

tidal_rush.name: Tidal Rush
tidal_rush.desc: A ground wave of water. It carries loose or incoming solids back at the rival, quenches lava into rock, douses fire fields and leaves puddles. Held: bigger, a Breaker, then the Deluge from the pool.

spray_fan.name: Spray Fan
spray_fan.desc: A fan of droplets: wets the rival (lightning x1.5), douses embers, cools hot rock, turns sand to mud. The Maelstrom tier leaves a mist cloud.

surge_orb.name: Surge Orb
surge_orb.desc: Guard flick up: hurl the water shield as an orb that bursts into a wetting splash and knocks back.

slick.name: Slick
slick.desc: Guard flick down: pour the shield as a 2.5 m puddle in front. Runners slip (-20 balance) and get wet. A puddle conducts lightning (careful) and freezes under Ice.

riptide_step.name: Riptide Step
riptide_step.desc: A slide on a film of water (leaves a slippery trail). In the pool: Dive - submerge and resurface 4 m away.

wave_ride.name: Wave Ride
wave_ride.desc: Hold evade: surf a self-made wave at 8 m/s for as long as the water lasts (2 kg/s).

frost_shard.name: Frost Shard
frost_shard.desc: A quick ice needle that chills. Held: Ice Lance, then the Glacier Spear (pierces one body and stands as an ice spike), then the Frost Comet, lobbed, which shatters into six shards.

icicle_volley.name: Icicle Volley
icicle_volley.desc: Needles of ice in a tight line: 3, held 5, 7, then 12.

rime_path.name: Rime Path
rime_path.desc: An ice sheet races along the ground and leaves a slick ice floor. It freezes puddles (no more conduction), turns a water wave into an ice ridge, crusts lava and makes a walkable strip over the pool. Held: longer ice, spikes, then a standing glacier ridge.

hoarfrost_fan.name: Hoarfrost Fan
hoarfrost_fan.desc: A freezing mist fan: chills (-30% speed), freezes WET targets solid (rooted), freezes streams in the air and puddles, cools hot rock and makes vines brittle.

ice_wall.name: Ice Wall
ice_wall.desc: A 50 kg wall of ice from the air's moisture (70 kg beside water); held it thickens. It stops solids and bolts (E up to 1.5 x its power: an insulator), freezes water that hits it and melts under fire. A perfect guard (Flash Freeze) freezes water, steam and mist solid and frost-locks light stones to the wall. Storm bolts, sound and blasts shatter it.

glacier_shove.name: Glacier Shove
glacier_shove.desc: Guard flick up: the ice wall slides forward 6 m on its own sheet, knocking back whoever it meets.

frost_floor.name: Frost Floor
frost_floor.desc: Guard flick down: a 3 m ice floor around you for 5 s. Enemies slide on it, your puddles freeze (lightning-safe).

freeze_draw.name: Freeze-Draw
freeze_draw.desc: Hold: draw water from the air as a growing ice block (up to 12 kg) or seize incoming ice or water (it freezes in your hand); drag to aim, release to throw. Attack while holding: Shatter, the block bursts into six shards.

ice_glide.name: Ice Glide
ice_glide.desc: A 5 m slide on a strip of ice that forms under you and lingers behind.

skate.name: Skate
skate.desc: Hold evade: ice forms under your feet; run at 7 m/s with almost no friction, across the pool too (frozen water won't conduct).

scald_puff.name: Scald Puff
scald_puff.desc: A puff of scalding steam (0.5 kg of water boiled by 40 HU). Held: Steam Jet, then a Geyser that erupts under the target and launches it, then three Boiling Pillars in a line.

fog_lance.name: Fog Lance
fog_lance.desc: A cold mist bolt, 12 m: wets, chills and blinds for 0.8 s. A cheap setup for lightning or frost; a puff of mist hangs where it ends.

creeping_fog.name: Creeping Fog
creeping_fog.desc: Mist rolls forward at 5 m/s and settles as a fog zone (r 4 m, 6 s; the Deluge-sized T3 r 6 m). Inside, lock-on breaks beyond 2 m, fire and blasts are dampened, and lightning cast into it hits everyone inside at 60%.

veil.name: Veil
veil.desc: A mist curtain wraps around you for 3 s: hard to target (lock-on breaks beyond 2 m) and fire and blasts are dampened inside.

steam_screen.name: Steam Screen
steam_screen.desc: A hot steam wall around you: flames lose heat, solids slow, ice melts, walkers are scalded and sight lines break. A perfect guard (Condense) pulls water, steam and mist into your waterskin and snuffs flames.

steam_blast.name: Steam Blast
steam_blast.desc: Guard flick up: the screen bursts forward in a 5 m cone of steam.

dew_fall.name: Dew Fall
dew_fall.desc: Guard flick down: all mist and steam within 6 m condenses into rain and falls as puddles. Clears your own fog; sets up conduction or freezing.

vapor_draw.name: Vapor Draw
vapor_draw.desc: Hold: draw mist, fog or steam (anyone's) into a held vapour ball; release hurls it as a steam bomb (scald cloud, 2.5 m). Attack while holding: Condense it into a water blob (throw it, or switch to Ice and freeze it).

mist_step.name: Mist Step
mist_step.desc: Dissolve and reform 4 m away: a puff of fog at both ends, hidden while you move.

fog_walk.name: Fog Walk
fog_walk.desc: Hold evade: walk inside your own mist, untargetable by lock-on beyond 2 m and hard for the AI to read; speed x0.7.

bramble_lash.name: Bramble Lash
bramble_lash.desc: A vine whip, 5 m: yanks light targets 2 m toward you. Held: longer thorns, then a grab-and-slam, then Briar Storm, a 360 degree whip.

burr_shot.name: Burr Shot
burr_shot.desc: Three burrs at 25 m/s. Where they land they sprout snares (root 1 s, r 1 m). Held: 5, 7, then a small grove.

root_snare.name: Root Snare
root_snare.desc: Roots race underground at 10 m/s (the ground cracks: a telegraph) and erupt under the target: rooted 1.2 s. Held: longer root, wider, then a Strangler Grove (r 3 m). Flying fighters pass over.

thicket_fan.name: Thicket Fan
thicket_fan.desc: A thorn thicket 120 degrees wide, 4 m deep, standing 4 s: slows by 40% and catches small projectiles.

living_lattice.name: Living Lattice
living_lattice.desc: A 40 kg wall of living vine (CP 16): captures solids, drinks water and grows, burns easily (x3), brittle when frozen. A perfect guard (Catch & Sling) catches the projectile and slings it back.

lattice_roll.name: Lattice Roll
lattice_roll.desc: Guard flick up: the lattice rolls forward as a tumble-ball, entangling whoever it meets (0.8 s).

deep_roots.name: Deep Roots
deep_roots.desc: Guard flick down: root yourself (no knockback, pull or lift; anchor CP 35) and drink the puddles under you into the waterskin. Holds as long as you hold guard.

vinegrip.name: Vinegrip
vinegrip.desc: Hold: lash a vine to a body of up to 40 kg at 9 m (half the usual range falloff: it wins long contests); drag to aim, release to throw. Attack while holding: Wrap, the body roots whoever it hits. On a fighter: Hook, yank 3 m toward you (-20 balance).

vine_swing.name: Vine Swing
vine_swing.desc: Swing on a vine to an anchor (wall, pillar, ledge) within 9 m in the direction you push; with none in reach, a sidestep.

canopy.name: Canopy
canopy.desc: Hold evade: hang from a canopy of vines and hover 1.5 s, passing over ground attacks.

fireball.name: Fireball / Twin / Great / Sunfall
fireball.desc: A ball of flame (a body carrying 120 HU) that bursts 2 m on impact. Air can grip and feed it, water quenches it, vacuum snuffs it. Held: two, then a 240 HU ball bursting 3 m, then Sunfall: lobbed, it leaves a 4 m burning field.

fire_line.name: Fire Line / Double / Triple / Fire Ring
fire_line.desc: Flames race 12 m/s along the ground for 10 m, leaving a burning trail. Stopped by water and sand; ignites vines; warms stones it passes. Held: two lines, three lines, then a ring of fire around the rival.

fire_fan.name: Fire Fan / Wide Fan / Wheel / Nova
fire_fan.desc: A 120 degree sweep of flame at 3.5 m that clears vines and mist. Held: wider, then a full 360 degree Nova.

flame_guard.name: Flame Guard / Heat Sink
flame_guard.desc: A guard of heat. Perfect: absorbs a flame's heat into the reserve (Heat Sink); against a magma blob or hot rock it draws 300 HU out instantly (it crusts mid-air); ice melts before it lands; returns a bolt with Return Current.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.desc: From the guard: release the whole heat reserve as a 5 m cone (H = reserve / 20, up to 25). Absorbed heat becomes the counter-attack.

ground_heat.name: Ground Heat
ground_heat.desc: From the guard: vent the heat reserve into the ground; it boils the puddles within 2 m and melts an ice floor. Your footing becomes lightning-safe.

flare_dash.name: Flare Dash
flare_dash.desc: A 4 m dash on a jet of flame (7 i-frames) that leaves a 1 s burning trail.

rocket_hop.name: Rocket Hop
rocket_hop.desc: Hold evade: hop 2.5 m on flame and hover for 0.6 s (reach the high ledge, dodge ground lines).

blue_needle.name: Blue Needle / Blue Lance / Searing Beam / White Core
blue_needle.desc: A thin blue beam (5 m). Held: an 8 m lance, then the Searing Beam (10 m, 0.6 s: melts a flying stone into a falling magma blob), then White Core (12 m, 1 s: melts through a stone wall, fuses sand walls into glass).

comet_flame.name: Comet Flame / Twin Comets / Great Comet / Piercing Comet
comet_flame.desc: A compact blue fireball @26 m/s. It boils water shields fast and melts ice walls on contact. Held: faster and hotter; T3 pierces fighters.

blue_furrow.name: Blue Furrow / Deep Furrow / Lava Channel / Magma Rift
blue_furrow.desc: Melts the ground along a line: a lava channel (1 kg/m from the ground, melted with your heat) that burns what it runs over and can be pushed by Earth / Magma Surge. Held: deeper, then a 6 m wide 12 m rift.

corona.name: Corona
corona.desc: A blue ring around you (2.5 m, 1 s): it burns whoever is inside, melts incoming ice and small metal, burns vines. Held: wider and longer (3.5 m).

blue_aegis.name: Blue Aegis
blue_aegis.desc: A hot blue aura (CP 16, 12 Focus/s). Ice and metal of 8 kg or less melt before they land; stones arrive as hot rock; flames are absorbed into your reserve (x1.5 on a perfect guard).

flash_over.name: Flash Over
flash_over.desc: From the guard: the aura explodes outward (3 m, H 10, knock 6).

kiln.name: Kiln
kiln.desc: From the guard: superheat a stone, metal, sand or glass body within 2.5 m to 600 °C or more (sand fuses to glass). A trap: whoever seizes it next is burned.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.desc: Hold: ranged heat at 6 m without a grip, 450 HU/s (1.5x Scorch). Walls slump (their face melts into lava you can send back), metal melts, sand fuses to glass, ice boils to steam.

shimmer_step.name: Shimmer Step
shimmer_step.desc: 3 m in 0.12 s through a heat haze (7 i-frames).

afterburn.name: Afterburn
afterburn.desc: Hold evade: run at 7 m/s leaving burning blue footprints.

spark.name: Spark / Bolt / Storm Bolt / Skybreak
spark.desc: Tap: a 5 m spark to the nearest target or conductor (chains 2 m to wet fighters and metal). Hold 0.65 s: the Bolt (14 m, conducts). Hold 1.2 s: the Storm Bolt blasts through barriers it out-powers and forks. Hold 1.8 s: Skybreak strikes the target from above (walls don't matter) and its thunder deafens.

rail_arc.name: Rail Arc
rail_arc.desc: A straight 16 m arc that follows the conductors it crosses: through a water jet or stream still connected to its caster, through metal, through a charged body.

ground_current.name: Ground Current / Surge / Network / Storm Grid
ground_current.desc: A current races 20 m/s along conductive ground only (puddles, the pool's edge, the metal plate, caltrops, mud); it dies 2 m onto dry stone. Frozen puddles and ice floors stop it; Grounding is immune. T3 Storm Grid electrifies every connected conductive surface for 1.5 s.

arc_fan.name: Arc Fan
arc_fan.desc: Three forks of lightning, 6 m over 60 degrees; each one chains through what it strikes.

static_ward.name: Static Ward / Return Current
static_ward.desc: A crackling guard (CP 12). A bolt that hits it is half stored as static (up to 60), half taken; metal shots are deflected (x1.5). Perfect with Return Current: the bolt goes back at 80 %; perfect without it: fully absorbed.

static_burst.name: Static Burst
static_burst.desc: From the guard: release the stored static as a 4 m cone (E = stored, a 0.3 s shock). Empty: a weak shove.

grounding.name: Grounding
grounding.desc: From the guard: 1.5 s immune to conducted damage (ground currents pass you, conduction skips you); drains the charge of conductors you touch.

conductors_hand.name: Conductor's Hand / Arc Link
conductors_hand.desc: Hold on a conductor within 10 m (metal, a water body, a puddle, fog, caltrops, a rod or an embedded lance): it stores charge (E by hold tier; decays 4/s; touching it shocks). Release with aim: a bolt jumps you -> the charged body -> the nearest rival within 8 m of it. Bank it around cover.

arc_step.name: Arc Step
arc_step.desc: 6 m in 0.1 s as a streak of lightning (9 i-frames); the trail shocks whoever it crossed (E 6).

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.desc: Hold evade: +30 % move speed and faster recoveries (x0.8) - but any water that hits you shocks you.

pop.name: Pop / Burst / Blast / Detonation
pop.desc: Tap: a palm detonation (2 m, knock 6). Hold: a Burst 6 m ahead, a Blast at 9 m (r 3), then the Detonation at 12 m (r 4.5, 0.5 s fuse). Blasts shatter ice and glass, snuff flames, disperse clouds; vacuum suppresses them, mist halves them, wind fans them.

spark_mine.name: Spark Mine
spark_mine.desc: Throw an ember @14 m/s that sticks where it lands; it detonates when a rival comes within 1.5 m, on contact, or when you flick up again.

chain_blasts.name: Chain Blasts
chain_blasts.desc: Three detonations step along the ground every 0.15 s (P 10 each). Held: four, five, six.

scatter_charges.name: Scatter Charges
scatter_charges.desc: Four embers fanned out to 6 m; each pops after 0.4 s (P 8). Area denial.

reactive_blast.name: Reactive Blast
reactive_blast.desc: When hit, detonate outward (CP 18, 8 Focus per trigger): light solids are blown aside, flames snuffed (x1.5), clouds dispersed. Perfect: light solids are blasted back at the thrower.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.desc: From the guard: a forward cone of blast (5 m, P 14): snuffs flames, shatters ice, pushes.

smother_blast.name: Smother Blast
smother_blast.desc: From the guard: a downward blast (P 10) that snuffs every fire field within 4 m and launches you 1.5 m up.

fuse.name: Fuse
fuse.desc: Hold: superheat a pocket of air at the aim point (10 m; steer it while holding, it grows with the hold). Release: it detonates there. In vapour x0.5, in a vacuum it fails, right after a vacuum well collapses x1.5; inside a tornado it makes a fire tornado.

blast_jump.name: Blast Jump
blast_jump.desc: A detonation at your feet launches you 4 m along the stick (straight up if neutral); it shoves whoever stands next to you.

afterglow.name: Afterglow
afterglow.desc: Hold evade: hover on small pops for 0.8 s.

gust_crescent.name: Wind Crescent
gust_crescent.desc: A crescent of cutting wind @22 m/s. Deflects the light shots it meets and cuts vines (x2). Hold: two crossing crescents, a 2 m wide one, then the Wind Scythe that pierces two targets.

gust_dust_line.name: Dust Devil Line
gust_dust_line.desc: A low line of wind races 14 m/s along the ground: trips (-30 balance), knocks up 3, raises dust (light blind). Hold: wider, stronger, longer.

gust_crosswind.name: Crosswind
gust_crosswind.desc: A lateral sweep of wind (120 deg, 5 m): shoves fighters sideways and curves the projectiles in flight by up to 40 deg - how far depends on how heavy and fast they are.

gust_wall.name: Wall of Wind
gust_wall.desc: From the guard: send the wind forward as a moving wall (8 m/s, 3 m wide, 6 m). Shoves fighters, turns light projectiles, carries clouds along.

gust_downdraft.name: Downdraft
gust_downdraft.desc: From the guard: a blast of wind driven down (r 3 m, P 12): slams airborne enemies to the ground (anti-flight), flattens fire fields, clears clouds.

gust_grip.name: Wind Grip
gust_grip.desc: Seize a light body (<= 30 kg: stone, water, ice, sand, steam, mist, a fireball) in the aim cone within 9 m with wind. Drag-aim, release to fling it. A gripped fireball is fed: +20 % heat.

gust_tailwind.name: Tailwind
gust_tailwind.desc: Hold EVADE: a wind at your back, x1.3 run speed while held (6 Focus/s).

vortex_twister.name: Twister / Tornado
vortex_twister.desc: A small vortex @12 m/s that lifts light targets and catches small shots it passes. Hold: twin twisters, then a Tornado (a zone that walks to the target for 4 s: it captures and orbits bodies up to 30 kg and lifts fighters) and the Cyclone Fortress (r 4 m, 6 s). Sand, fire, water or steam in it infuse it - the enemy's material turns it neutral.

vortex_spiral.name: Spiral Lance
vortex_spiral.desc: A drilling spiral of wind @24 m/s. Pierces mist, sand clouds and sand walls; stone and metal walls turn it. Hold: faster, stronger, pierces fighters.

vortex_funnel.name: Dust Funnel
vortex_funnel.desc: A ground vortex races 10 m/s: it gathers the loose bodies on its path and carries them to the target, where they are released as your attack - the arena's rubble becomes ammunition.

vortex_eddy.name: Eddy Ring
vortex_eddy.desc: A ring vortex (r 3 m) around you for 1.5 s: projectiles curve around you - orbit-deflected, sometimes straight back at the thrower - and light fighters are pushed out.

vortex_wall.name: Vortex Wall
vortex_wall.desc: A spinning barrier around you. It captures light projectiles - they orbit inside - instead of stopping them; heavier ones pass bent, flames are fed and spun. Perfect: Vortex Catch grabs even heavier shots and flings them faster. Flick up: Unleash. Flick down: Funnel Down. Weak to water mass and a Vacuum Well.

vortex_unleash.name: Unleash
vortex_unleash.desc: From the Vortex Wall: fling everything it captured at the target. Each body keeps its mass and heat and flies as YOUR attack (a new attack id); a perfectly caught shot flies 25 % faster.

vortex_funnel_down.name: Funnel Down
vortex_funnel_down.desc: From the Vortex Wall: drive the vortex into the ground - a dust crater - and drop the captured bodies at your feet, ready for Earth or Water to seize.

vortex_eye.name: Eye of the Storm
vortex_eye.desc: Create a tornado at the aim point (10 m) and steer it by dragging the aim while you hold; release and it lives 2 s more. Over an enemy tornado: a contest - strong enough, you take it over (and steer it); merged with your own it grows. Hold longer: bigger, stronger.

vortex_spin_step.name: Spin Step
vortex_spin_step.desc: A spinning sidestep (3 m, 10 i-frames) that turns light projectiles aside while you spin.

vortex_whirl.name: Whirl Lift
vortex_whirl.desc: Hold EVADE: hover 1.5 m in a small vortex of your own (8 Focus/s). Ground lines pass under you; projectiles curve around the vortex.

vacuum_palm.name: Pressure Palm / Air Cannon / Implode / Collapse
vacuum_palm.desc: A point-blank burst of pressure (knock 8, -30 balance). Hold: a 12 m pressure bullet (Air Cannon), then Implode - a vacuum point 8 m ahead that pulls 3 m for 0.4 s and collapses - and Collapse (r 4 m, crush -60 balance). Flames inside a vacuum die; sound inside dies.

vacuum_suction.name: Suction Line
vacuum_suction.desc: A suction beam (10 m): pulls the fighter it meets 2 m toward you - or pulls YOU to a wall or anchor. Light projectiles (<= 12 kg) it meets are yanked into your hand.

vacuum_mine.name: Pressure Mine
vacuum_mine.desc: A pressure trap (r 1.2 m, 10 s) buried 2 m ahead. A fighter who steps on it is blown 7 m up. Hold: stronger.

vacuum_arc.name: Vacuum Arc
vacuum_arc.desc: A near-vacuum crescent (100 deg, 4 m): snuffs the flames in the arc (x2), silences sound, and pulls what it meets a little toward you.

vacuum_bubble.name: Null Bubble
vacuum_bubble.desc: A vacuum shell around you (r 1.8 m, CP 14): fire and combustion die in it (x2), sound is nullified (x3), mist and steam collapse into water, lightning with E <= 1.5 x CP is blocked (a stronger bolt is weakened). Solids and liquids simply pass. Perfect: Vacuum Catch - a light projectile is caught and spat back. Flick up: Pressure Wave. Flick down: Anchor. Weak to a gale that fills it (x1.2).

vacuum_wave.name: Pressure Wave
vacuum_wave.desc: From the Null Bubble: the bubble collapses outward as a ring (r 3 m, P 16): shoves everything near you back.

vacuum_anchor.name: Anchor
vacuum_anchor.desc: From the Null Bubble: a low-pressure anchor while held (CP 35): immune to knockback, pulls and tornado lift. You barely move (x0.3).

vacuum_well.name: Vacuum Well
vacuum_well.desc: A suction zone at the aim point (9 m, r 3 m) while you hold: it pulls projectiles out of the air (they hang in the well), pulls and compresses clouds (steam -> water, sand -> sandstone), drags fighters (-40 % moving away) and puts fire out. Release: it collapses - what it held is crushed and the air rushes in (a combustion there x1.5). Hold longer: stronger, wider.

vacuum_hop.name: Pressure Hop
vacuum_hop.desc: A leap 3 m up and forward (9 i-frames) on a cushion of low pressure: a float landing without landing lag.

vacuum_slipstream.name: Slipstream
vacuum_slipstream.desc: Hold EVADE: x1.3 speed in a low-pressure wake; projectiles behind you are slowed (6 Focus/s).

sound_clap.name: Clap / Shout / Roar / Resonance
sound_clap.desc: A cone of sound: Clap (3 m, 60 deg, daze) -> Shout (7 m) -> Roar (10 m: shatters ice, glass and thin walls, rains out mist, -8 Focus) -> Resonance (12 m: shatters any brittle body, deafens 2 s). Disrupts charges and channels when its pressure reaches their cohesion (6 + 4 x tier). Sand, fog and vines absorb it; stone and metal walls throw it back; a vacuum nullifies it; it passes through water.

sound_lance.name: Sound Lance
sound_lance.desc: A focused pulse (14 m, a visible ring): passes through water and mist, reflects off stone and metal walls and the arena walls - bank it around cover. Hold: stronger and longer.

sound_tremor.name: Tremor Hum
sound_tremor.desc: A ground hum races 18 m/s for 10 m: knocks fighters over (-35 balance), cracks the walls it passes, and pops loose stones into the air where they can be seized from range.

sound_echo_ring.name: Echo Ring
sound_echo_ring.desc: A ring of sound (r 4 m) all around you: reveals everyone hiding (fog, Mist Step, Fog Walk, burrowers) and interrupts the channels and charges its pressure reaches.

sound_barrier.name: Sound Barrier
sound_barrier.desc: A vibrating front (CP 12): ice and glass shatter against it (x2.5), light solids are turned, sound is cancelled. Perfect: Echo Return throws incoming sound back at its source. A vacuum nullifies it, sand absorbs it, heavy solids ignore it. Flick up: Thunder Step. Flick down: Ground Ping.

sound_thunder_step.name: Thunder Step
sound_thunder_step.desc: From the guard: a 4 m boom-dash forward that shoves everything in front of you (P 14).

sound_ping.name: Ground Ping
sound_ping.desc: From the guard: a pulse through the ground (r 6 m, strength by guard hold): reveals burrowers and disrupts the ground lines whose power it matches - spike lines, currents, roots, sand surges.

sound_flight.name: Flight
sound_flight.desc: Rise to 2.2 m and fly at 6 m/s with every attack still usable (6 Focus + 10/s). Press again to glide down. Airborne: ground lines, quicksand and ice floors do nothing to you; gusts and tornadoes blow you around (x1.5 balance) and a lightning bolt has no ground to run to.

sound_boom_step.name: Boom Step
sound_boom_step.desc: A 6 m supersonic dash (9 i-frames) that ends in a boom: knock 3 on everyone within 2 m.

sound_hover.name: Hover
sound_hover.desc: Hold EVADE: hold your height in the air (6 Focus/s). Ground lines pass under you.
